rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the press-conference record 安倍内閣総理大臣記者会見 dated 12 September 2007, Abe opens by saying he resolved that day to resign the office of Prime Minister (本日、総理の職を辞するべきと決意), and that he had told the party executives to choose the next party president quickly.
